doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

The footage study lists 'whether you can shoot during it [Spirit Walk]' as an open question (briefs/hero-ref/pin.md:247); the roll itself is 0.1-0.15 s (pin.md:322-327); air: not shown (pin.md:330-331). lmb.source: Owner item 51 names Lace's draw: it carries through a dash. Neither the data (Myth: Greenwood Bow, Phase Walk) nor the footage (pin.md: Spirit Walk) shows the roll ending a draw, so Shift mid-draw rolls at once and the draw carries on.

ground.source: Not determinable. Footage (briefs/hero-ref/pin.md:33-47): the draw is a hold; she walks slowly while drawing and keeps moving (f111-116, frames 0111-0116); no Shift or jump pressed inside a draw (the roll is seen only at 0388-0389, bare: pin.md:322-327). Open question pin.md:247 'whether you can shoot during it'. Air dash and jump not shown (pin.md:330-334). Data: briefs/supervive-data/supervive_kits.md:73,75,78 (Myth: Greenwood Bow, Phase Walk, the roll test) have nothing on a draw through a roll. Kept: the hold carries through (owner item 51).
